tradeoffs: aesctr needs AES-NI; lehmer64 uses 128-bit multiply; aesctr is a stream cipher, not a classic PRNG.
caveats: 'mersennetwister' is the repo's own MT implementation, not libstdc++'s std::mt19937. Benchmark stresses throughput, not latency; ARM results may differ. Exact optimization flags are in CMake and not quoted. Other winners (wyrand, splitmix64, aesdragontamer) overlap known entries.
